doctor family is subaction-route-manifest (confirm-only, presentation-asset owner); check/apply/align each become a new route: router .md + _routes.yaml entry + doctor-<name>.yaml + doctor-<name>-presentation.txt, then route-validate.sh; command-contract.json doctor entry (router_path, execution_targets, owned_assets, destructive_policy, invocation_aliases, argument_hint) must be extended to match

thin-router anatomy is uniform in update.md: frontmatter + skill_agent comment; Router Contract (no agent dispatch, no YAML edits while executing); Owned Assets; Mode Routing; Execution Targets (bind setup before loading YAML); Presentation Boundary; Workflow Summary

.opencode/SYNC.md: .skilled is source of truth and .opencode entries are relative per-entry symlinks, so no copy-sync step is needed; reuse the S4 broken/off-tree integrity loop; only npm ci in .opencode and hook installers are real install steps

projection families have generator+checker pairs: leaf-manifest (generate-leaf-manifest --write/--check, ci-leaf-manifest-freshness), graph-metadata.derived (regenerate-skill-derived --write, default dry-run, preserve-first; ci-skill-derived-freshness), compiled-routing closure (compiled-route-sync --check/--verify), router intent signals, version frontmatter (frontmatter-version apply/verify, check-frontmatter-versions.sh gate)

projection regeneration must be inside the same apply transaction: each projection is byte-gated, so updating children without regenerating leaves the tree failing its own gates; order = snapshot -> skill writes -> regenerate projections -> run all --check gates + route-validate + symlink integrity -> advisor graph rebuild -> state log

doctor-update.yaml forbidden_targets bans .skilled/skills/**/SKILL.md and .skilled/commands/doctor/**; allowed_targets are DB/dist/lock paths; invariant is a DB-rebuild flock chain. Release apply needs its own route/mutation boundaries with git-based rollback; DB rebuild is retained (standalone /doctor:update or apply final phase)

install scripts are hook-scoped, not tree-sync: install-git-hooks.sh + check-git-hooks.sh, install-codex-hooks.mjs; re-run only when the release touches hook definitions, guarded by their check counterparts

direction: Fold release-aware apply into doctor-update.yaml as a new phase
reason: doctor-update.yaml mutation_boundaries.forbidden_targets explicitly bans .skilled/skills/**/SKILL.md and .skilled/commands/doctor/** writes; its invariant is DB-rebuild-specific (single flock, per-DB snapshot/restore). Folding in would rewrite the safety contract its decision-record ADRs guard, and couples source-tree rollback (git) with DB-snapshot rollback

direction: Add a copy/sync step from .skilled/ to .opencode/ as part of apply
reason: .opencode entries are relative per-entry symlinks onto .skilled; the sync manifest states drift is impossible for linked entries (a symlink has no content). A copy step would create a second source of truth and a new drift class; only the S4 integrity loop and (on SDK-pin changes) npm ci are needed

Doctor family mode_matrix is confirm-only with supported_modes [] and no command uses overrides; destructive doctor routes gate per phase boundary. New routes should stay confirm-gated, with check read-only and dry-run as an explicit flag on apply
